children: Ryan Cohen, a director reporting as President, CEO and Chairman, purchased 1,000,000 shares of Class A Common Stock at a weighted average price of $20.3759 per share. The total purchase amount reported is $20,375,900. Following the transaction, Cohen directly owns 39,347,842 shares of Class A Common Stock. The footnote states the shares were bought in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $20.0199 to $20.4699 and that full allocation details will be provided upon request.
